description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to a Class Sui Generis (HMO - house in multiple occupation) with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Site Location Plan 1610-00 Dated 06.04.2026;Proposed Block Plan 1610-200 RevA Dated 20.04.2026;Proposed Ground & First Floor Plans 1610-210 RevA 20.04.2026;Proposed Second Floor & Roof Plan 1610-220 Dated 06.04.2026;Proposed Outbuilding Plan 1610-230 RevA Dated 20.04.2026;Proposed Elevations 1610-240 Dated 06.04.2026;Proposed Section AA 1610-250 Dated 06.04.2026;Cycle Store Details 1610-500 Dated 06.04.2026;Planning Statement 1610/PS Dated 06.04.2026;Design & Access Statement 1610/DAS Dated 06.04.2026;Flood Risk Assessment 1610/FRA Dated 06.04.2026;Fire Safety Statement 1610/FS Dated 06.04.2026;Highway Safety Impact Assessment;SuDS Proforma.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than seven residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to first occupation of the HMO, Cycle parking, shall be provided as indicated on drawing "Proposed Block Plan 1610-200 Rev A dated 20.04.2026", in accordance with the following requirements:o Provision of a minimum of SEVEN long stay cycle parking spaces;o in an accessible location; the store door must have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo long stay cycle parking spaces secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob;o fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Reason: To ensure the provision of accessible, secure, and adequate cycle parking facilities and to safeguard the character and appearance of the area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the occupiers of adjoining premises; protect the general environment; prevent any obstruction to pedestrian movement and to ensure that there are adequate facilities for the storage and recycling of recoverable materials.

The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used as accommodation ancillary to and in connection with the approved Sui Generis House in Multiple Occupation at 128 St Peters Road, Enfield, N9 8JL, and shall not be occupied as a separate self-contained residential unit or as a separate planning unit at any time.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding remains subordinate to the main HMO use and does not result in an independent residential unit that would adversely affect the amenity of adjoining occupiers and the proper planning of the area, in accordance with Development Plan policies.
